name: fix118_teach_list
verifies: fix-118: Norris's lesson list (sub-choices of the hero's 'Ты научишь меня драться?') stays open after a refused lesson (Perk_1H_2: STR 100 < 150) and after a learned one (Сила +1), as G3 OnInfoScriptFinished re-shows the parent's children; '...назад' returns to the topics. Lesson labels carry the price (G3 GetDialogDescription): 'Сила +1 (1 Оч. обучения, 50 Золото)'.
notes: Norris is no teacher at first (G3: his 'Покажи мне, как вы деретесь?' BPANKRATZ31239, offered after 'Что ты здесь делаешь?' BPANKRATZ31238 set Norris_HisDuties, gives him the Teach role), so the hero asks both first, the player's way (fix-121); only then the teach topic (needsAvailableChild) is offered. SKALVERAM334 = 'Ты научишь меня драться?', SKALVERAM31098 = Perk_1H_2 (refused: STR), SKALVERAM31034 = 'Сила +1' (1 LP, 50 gold), SKALVERAM31032 = '...назад'. The refusal's HUD lines (fix-84) need the content re-imported; the list behaviour and labels do not. Rules covered by Myrtana.Tests TeachListTests.
